features: 单实例多数据库动态切换
数据库连接管理（连接测试、配置刷新、健康检查、自动重连）
数据库架构查询（数据库列表、表列表、视图列表、表结构、列信息、主键、索引等）
数据库架构操作（创建/删除/重命名表、添加/删除/修改列、索引管理、约束管理等）
高级查询（多结果集、标量值、IN参数查询）
数据操作（参数化执行 DML）
存储过程调用（简单调用、带输出参数）
批量操作（批量执行命令）
SQL Server 特殊支持（GO 语句执行）
参数化查询防止 SQL 注入
数据库特定性能优化（连接池、查询优化、类型映射等）
security: 参数化查询防止 SQL 注入

name: io.github.ttcc666/database-mcp-server
description: 一个功能强大的数据库操作 MCP 服务器，支持 34 种数据库类型，包括主流数据库、国产数据库、分布式数据库、时序数据库等。通过 JSON 配置文件管理多数据库连接，支持单实例多数据库动态切换，提供数据库连接管理、架构查询与操作、高级查询、数据操作、存储过程调用、事务处理和性能优化等功能。

environmentVariables.name: DB_CONFIG_PATH
environmentVariables.description: 数据库配置文件绝对路径（必需），如 D:\config\databases.json。配置文件格式请参考 databases.json.example

environmentVariables.name: SEQ_SERVER_URL
environmentVariables.description: Seq 日志服务器地址（可选），如 http://localhost:5341

environmentVariables.name: SEQ_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Seq API 密钥（可选），用于认证和高级功能

environmentVariables.name: DB_DDL_WHITELIST
environmentVariables.description: DDL 操作白名单（可选），分号分隔的正则表达式，用于放行特定的 DDL 操作

tools.name: test_connection
tools.description: Run SELECT 1 on the currently active connection and return success, connected, currentDatabase, and databaseType so callers can confirm the session is healthy.

tools.name: test_connection_by_name
tools.description: Test connection for a specific database by name and return success, connected, and databaseType.

tools.name: list_databases
tools.description: List all available database connections configured in databases.json and return name, description, dbType, and isDefault for each.

tools.name: switch_database
tools.description: Switch to a specified database connection by name and return success to indicate the switch completed.

tools.name: get_current_database
tools.description: Get the name of the currently active database connection.

tools.name: health_check
tools.description: Perform health check on all database connections and return response time, connection status, and error messages for each.

tools.name: test_connection_with_retry
tools.description: Test connection with automatic retry using exponential backoff strategy and return success, attempts, and total elapsed time.

tools.name: get_database_config
tools.description: Summarize DB_CONFIG_PATH configuration and return the active connection name, description, database type, masked connection string, and mode metadata.

tools.name: validate_configuration
tools.description: Verify whether the environment variables or config file can produce a usable connection and return success/configured/currentDatabase/databaseType/message fields describing the outcome.

tools.name: reload_database_config
tools.description: Reload databases.json from DB_CONFIG_PATH, refresh cached clients, and return the applied current database plus whether the previous selection was preserved.

tools.name: get_data_base_list
tools.description: Call DbMaintenance.GetDataBaseList to retrieve every database the instance can see and return it inside the data array.

tools.name: get_view_info_list
tools.description: Use DbMaintenance.GetViewInfoList to pull metadata for every view (name, definition, schema) so clients can inventory logical objects.

tools.name: get_table_info_list
tools.description: Use DbMaintenance.GetTableInfoList(false) to return basic information for each table (name, description, creation time) inside data.

tools.name: get_column_infos_by_table_name
tools.description: Accept a tableName and return every column with data type, length, nullable flag, and other metadata via DbMaintenance.GetColumnInfosByTableName.

tools.name: get_is_identities
tools.description: Return all identity (auto-increment) columns for the provided tableName so callers know whether an identity key exists.

tools.name: get_primaries
tools.description: Return primary key metadata for the provided tableName, including the constraint name, columns, and ordinal order for composite keys.

tools.name: is_any_table
tools.description: Check whether tableName exists in the current database and return an exists boolean.

tools.name: is_any_column
tools.description: Check whether columnName exists on tableName and return an exists boolean.

tools.name: is_any_constraint
tools.description: Check whether the specified constraintName exists (unique, foreign key, or check constraint) and return an exists boolean.

tools.name: drop_table
tools.description: Immediately drop the specified tableName, removing both structure and data, and return success to indicate completion.

tools.name: truncate_table
tools.description: Execute TRUNCATE on tableName to delete all rows while preserving the schema; the response includes success.

tools.name: backup_table
tools.description: Use DbMaintenance.BackupTable to copy oldTableName to newTableName, duplicating both schema and current data.

tools.name: rename_table
tools.description: Rename oldTableName to newTableName and return success so callers know the rename succeeded.

tools.name: add_column
tools.description: Add a column on tableName using columnInfo JSON (DbColumnName, DataType, Length, IsNullable, etc.) to describe the new definition.

tools.name: update_column
tools.description: Modify an existing column on tableName using the supplied columnInfo JSON to specify DbColumnName, DataType, Length, IsNullable, and other properties.

tools.name: drop_column
tools.description: Drop the specified columnName from tableName and return success.

tools.name: rename_column
tools.description: Rename oldColumnName to newColumnName within tableName to adjust field naming.

tools.name: add_primary_key
tools.description: Create a primary key constraint on tableName for columnName, useful when introducing a single-column key.

tools.name: drop_constraint
tools.description: Drop the specified constraintName from tableName (primary key, unique index, foreign key, etc.) and return success.

tools.name: create_index
tools.description: Create an index named indexName for tableName.columnName; set isUnique to true to build a unique index and return success.

tools.name: get_index_list
tools.description: List every index defined on tableName (name and attributes) and return it in the data array.

tools.name: add_default_value
tools.description: Set defaultValue on tableName.columnName by invoking DbMaintenance.AddDefaultValue.

tools.name: add_table_remark
tools.description: Attach a description to tableName so documentation tools can surface the table’s purpose.

tools.name: is_any_table_remark
tools.description: Return exists to show whether tableName already has a stored remark.

tools.name: delete_table_remark
tools.description: Remove the remark/description associated with tableName and return success.

tools.name: add_column_remark
tools.description: Attach a description to tableName.columnName, making the column meaning visible to downstream tools.

tools.name: delete_column_remark
tools.description: Delete the stored description for tableName.columnName and return success.

tools.name: get_proc_list
tools.description: List every stored procedure name in the current database and place the collection in data.

tools.name: get_func_list
tools.description: List every database function name so callers can audit reusable logic.

tools.name: drop_view
tools.description: Drop the specified viewName definition and return success.

tools.name: drop_func
tools.description: Drop the database function identified by functionName, typically during cleanup.

tools.name: drop_proc
tools.description: Drop the stored procedure identified by procedureName and return success.

tools.name: get_trigger_names
tools.description: List every trigger defined on tableName to expose side effects that may fire on DML.

tools.name: get_table_schema
tools.description: Return a combined schema document for tableName including columns, primary keys, identity columns, and indexes.

tools.name: sql_query
tools.description: Execute a read-only SQL statement with dangerous-operation detection, optionally binding JSON parameters, and return rowCount plus data.

tools.name: sql_query_single
tools.description: Execute a read-only SQL statement and return only the first row (or null) with the same optional JSON parameters.

tools.name: get_data_set_all
tools.description: Execute SQL that may contain multiple SELECT statements and return each result set with its rowCount inside resultSets.

tools.name: get_scalar
tools.description: Return the first-row, first-column value from the SQL statement—ideal for COUNT/SUM scalar queries.

tools.name: sql_query_with_in_parameter
tools.description: Bind a JSON array to an IN parameter (inParameterName) plus optional otherParameters to safely execute IN-clause queries and return the rows.

tools.name: execute_command
tools.description: Execute INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE SQL after dangerous-operation detection, optionally binding JSON parameters, and return affectedRows.

tools.name: call_stored_procedure
tools.description: Invoke the specified stored procedure with optional JSON parameters and return the resulting rows and rowCount.

tools.name: call_stored_procedure_with_output
tools.description: Invoke a stored procedure with JSON input parameters and a list of output parameter names; return rows plus the output parameter values.

tools.name: execute_command_with_go
tools.description: Execute a SQL Server script that contains GO batches, automatically splitting the script and returning total affectedRows.

tools.name: batch_execute_commands
tools.description: Execute a JSON array of SQL commands (with optional per-command parameter dictionaries) over a single long-lived connection and return success, affectedRows, or error per command.
